# onetsolutions_hosting_plans (Data Source)

Lists the web hosting plans on sale.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_hosting_plans" "all" {}

output "hosting_plan_slugs" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_hosting_plans.all.plans[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) The plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth_mb` (Number) The monthly bandwidth, in MB; 0 means unlimited.
- `description` (String) The description of the plan (Markdown).
- `disk_space_mb` (Number) The disk space, in MB; 0 means unlimited.
- `hosting_type` (String) `hostingaccount` (standard) or `reselleraccount` (reseller).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the plan.
- `max_addon_domains` (Number) The most addon domains; 0 means unlimited.
- `max_databases` (Number) The most databases; 0 means unlimited.
- `max_email_accounts` (Number) The most e-mail accounts; 0 means unlimited.
- `max_ftp_accounts` (Number) The most FTP accounts; 0 means unlimited.
- `max_subdomains` (Number) The most subdomains; 0 means unlimited.
- `name` (String) The name of the plan.
- `pricing` (Attributes List) The price of the plan for each billing cycle, excluding VAT. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans--pricing))
- `slug` (String) The slug of the plan.

<a id="nestedatt--plans--pricing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans.pricing`

Read-Only:

- `billing_cycle` (String) The billing cycle, such as `monthly`.
- `discount_percent` (String) The discount of the cycle, in percent.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the plan's default cycle.
- `price` (String) The price per cycle, in EUR, as a decimal string.
